readerNotes.line: Enters at the north edge near the Maas (5.88E 51.17N), runs east along 51.0N past Geilenkirchen, then down the Roer past Duren to Monschau. The bulge: north shoulder near Malmedy and Stavelot, west tip near 5.30E 50.09N (narrow salient between the 6th Airborne and the 51st), south side past Bastogne, then east along the Sauer and down the Moselle, leaving the east edge near 6.85E 49.21N. Around Aachen and Monschau the heavy front line runs beside the hatched Westwall band and can be confused with it; I followed the plain heavy ticked line. The heavy line across 50.15N to 50.17N west of Marche is the army group boundary, not the front.
